integrity: The all-parameter theorem uses two exact polynomial identities with degree-bound interpolation and positive coefficients; full-graph checks corroborate. Priority beyond inspected literature is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Complete tripartite, integers a>=2 and b>=c>=1, target in a-part, independent uniform two-neighbor offers with replacement; expected target hitting time only. No all-deadline or four-part conclusion.
title: Size-only optimal two-choice hitting on complete tripartite graphs
